Selected works.

Self-initiated design projects.

(01) · Concept Project / 2026

Monster Energy

F&B / Dynamic Compositing

MONSTER ENERGY is a conceptual commercial campaign built to shift the brand's visual narrative: moving from raw adrenaline to a refined, early-morning performance utility.

By pairing rugged stone textures with controlled sunrise rim-lighting, the compositing transforms a static drink can into an atmospheric, high-impact hero product.

Role: Digital Imaging & Advertising Compositor
Tools: Adobe Photoshop

(02) · Concept Project / 2026

Orabi

Luxury & Beauty Advertising

ORABI is a conceptual luxury fragrance campaign designed to overcome the core challenge of perfume advertising: translating an invisible scent into a tangible visual experience.

Through precise water compositing, light refraction balance, and clean atmospheric grading, the composition renders the product's fresh ocean narrative instantly felt before it is smelled.

Role: Digital Imaging & Advertising Compositor
Tools: Adobe Photoshop

(03) · Concept Project / 2026

Headphone Hush

Minimalist Electronics Ad

HEADPHONE HUSH is a conceptual tech campaign built to communicate active noise cancellation through visual silence, proving that the loudest feature can be expressed through absolute emptiness.

By pairing precise edge lighting with pristine negative space, the composition relies solely on sleek product contours and absolute visual purity to make quietness tangible.

Role: Digital Imaging & Advertising Compositor
Tools: Adobe Photoshop

(04) · Concept Project / 2026

Own Your Presence

Fashion & Lifestyle Campaign

OWN YOUR PRESENCE is a conceptual fashion campaign crafted to blur the line between commercial advertising and high-fashion editorial design.

By juxtaposing bold typography layering with clean subject isolation, the composition commands attention, transforming a simple portrait into an assertion of confidence and brand attitude.

Role: Digital Imaging & Advertising Compositor
Tools: Adobe Photoshop

(05) · Concept Project / 2026

Aim Higher

Motivational Key Art

AIM HIGHER is a conceptual key art piece built to turn an overused growth chart into a human gesture: a hand reaching for the goal instead of a graph simply rising.

By pairing a monochromatic purple gradient with directional glow concentrated at the arrow tip, the composition keeps the eye on the destination and elevates a familiar business metaphor into an aspirational visual.

Role: Key Art Designer
Tools: Adobe Photoshop
